title: FIX make Bunch.copy return a Bunch instead of a dict
body:
#### Reference Issues/PRs
Fixes #27930.

#### What does this implement/fix? Explain your changes.
`Bunch` inherits `dict.copy`, which always returns a plain `dict`, so `Bunch(a=1).copy().a` raises `AttributeError`. `copy.copy(bunch)` already returns a `Bunch`, so the two ways of copying disagree.

This adds a `Bunch.copy` override that returns a `Bunch`. It is still a shallow copy.

Points worth a careful look:

- Keys are copied with `dict.update`, which does not go through `Bunch.__getitem__`, so copying a bunch that holds deprecated keys does not emit their `FutureWarning`.
- The `_deprecated_key_to_warnings` table is copied rather than shared, so deprecated keys still warn on the copy and later `_set_deprecated` calls on one bunch do not affect the other. This differs slightly from the snippet suggested in the issue, which shared the table.

title: FIX resolve midpoint rounding tie in HistGradientBoosting binning
body:
Fixes  #35119
 
In  find_binning_thresholds  ( sklearn.ensemble._hist_gradient_boosting.binning ), when the number of distinct values is less than or equal to  max_bins, bin thresholds are calculated as midpoints of adjacent distinct values.

In IEEE-754 binary64 arithmetic, computing the arithmetic midpoint of two adjacent, distinct floating-point values can round upward to equal the upper data value due to round to the nearest ties to even. Because bin mapping uses upper inclusive comparisons (<= threshold), both values were placed into the same bin, preventing trees from splitting perfectly separable data.

title: Fix: move_estimator_to should not move classes_ attribute
body:
This PR fixes Issue #35109. 

**Reasoning:**
When utilizing `move_estimator_to` to transition estimators to different devices (e.g., CPU to GPU), the recursive `_estimator_with_converted_arrays` method was blindly converting all attributes. This caused problems for the `classes_` array (which often holds string labels that are incompatible with certain target namespaces/devices).

**Changes Made:**
- Added an explicit check to bypass the `classes_` attribute during the recursive conversion in `_estimator_with_converted_arrays`. The attribute is now transferred as-is without device modification.
- Added a non-regression test in `test_array_api.py` to verify this behavior.

Fixes #35109
